data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 17.8m (2015: favourable development of GBP 16.6m); this comprises releases of GBP 17.4m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, releases of GBP 0.2m in respect of direct Aviation and Transport business and GBP 0.2m in respect of total Reinsurance business.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a material gross favourable prior-year development across older underwriting years (2011-2014) of approximately GBP 89.7m (gross release), which after reinsurance resulted in a reported net favourable development of GBP 17.8m. The release was driven predominantly by favourable development in Third Party Liability, with small releases in Aviation/Transport and reinsurance acceptances. The gross result was calculated from the published gross claims development table; the notes present only the net (after reinsurance) breakout.
raw_causal_phrases: prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes.

The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 17.8m (2015: favourable development of GBP 16.6m); this comprises releases of GBP 17.4m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, releases of GBP 0.2m in respect of direct Aviation and Transport business and GBP 0.2m in respect of total Reinsurance business.
data.data_quality_notes: The movement note (Note 6) reports only NET prior-year development (net of reinsurance recoveries = GBP 17.8m). A gross prior-year movement was not stated directly in that note; therefore the gross prior-year development was calculated from the published gross claims development (triangle). The gross PYD derived from the triangle is -GBP 89.734m (release). Per-LOB breakdowns in the movement note appear to be net amounts; lob_movements use those net per-LOB figures with lower confidence. All monetary conversions to millions were performed from the report's GBP '000 presentation. Rounding differences may exist.
